profile.headline: Open Source Lead @ CrewAI | Speaker | Building Agentic Systems & Open-Source Tools
profile.summary:
Experienced in engineering agentic automations as well as building developer tools.

Also interested in engaging community through building in public, educating others, and sharing experiences along the journey.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Leads CrewAI’s open-source repositories, I focus on agent reliability, AI tooling, observability and evals. The CrewAI library supports 15M+ monthly downloads, over a billion agentic workflow executions in 2025, and a has supported over 70% of Fortune 500 companies.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Software Infrastructure · Ruby on Rails · Ruby

positions.title: Owner / Software Developer
positions.description: Boutique IT and Development Services specializing in helping technology companies and creative businesses develop their complex designs and optimize their systems and workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Mac · Node.js · Business Strategy · Branding · Marketing Strategy · Easily Adaptable · Website Building · Web Design · Marketing · Graphics · HTML · Technical Documentation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer responsible for building end to end internal and customer facing applications. Technology stack included TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js, PostgreSQL database, and AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · React.js · JavaScript · Technical Documentation · NestJS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software Developer focused on UI / UX Engineering, building VS Code extensions utilizing technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Reactjs, Next.js, Node.js, TailwindCSS, MaterialUI, OOP, and Deno.
positions.insights: Skills: Mac · Node.js · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · React.js · Easily Adaptable · Next.js · GitHub · Software Development · HTML · Technical Documentation · Front-End Development · User Experience (UX)

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Design Systems Frontend Developer building UI components, writing usage documentation, and working with stakeholders spread across HackForLA.
positions.insights: Skills: Mac · Node.js · HTML · Technical Documentation
